beats.plot: Ankita closes the upper two buttons of her existing cream embroidered kurti, adjusts her tailored beige blazer, smooths her trouser fit and collects office documents. This is a continuity anchor: Rohit sees her normally dressed, not the more daring briefing look.

beats.name: Rohit arrives with the post-release equipment return kit
beats.plot: Rohit, 22, a real junior IT support/office helper already listed in the character directory, arrives for AV adapter, docking unit and office kit collection after the sign-off. Introduce his work habits, courteous manner and everyday usefulness without inventing a prior intimate relationship.

beats.name: First nickname exchange
beats.plot: Ankita uses the affectionate workplace nickname 'Rohit Babu' (office Chotu) when asking for help with the kit; Rohit reacts lightly and asks why. Their ordinary exchange distinguishes him from the confident seniors Bhalla and Sandeep.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Arre Rohit Babu, kit mein sab samaan aa gaya?

dialogue.speaker: Rohit
dialogue.line: Ma'am, sab Rohit bulate hain. Aap Rohit Babu kyun?

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Kyunki meri har technical emergency mein tum hi pehle aa jaate ho. Ab list check karo, Babu.

beats.name: Helpfulness and human familiarity
beats.plot: Ankita notices he has been handling holiday support despite being a junior. She thanks him, offers water/tea as a simple courtesy and briefly asks how his shift is going. Rohit responds courteously; he is not made into an inexperienced cartoon. Any family financial support backstory is not yet established and must be requested or written separately before it is treated as canon.

beats.name: Small handover task reserved for tomorrow
beats.plot: The equipment inventory sheet has an incomplete asset acknowledgement, which cannot be finalized until the next office shift. Rohit agrees to bring the corrected slip on 2 Jan. This is a story scheduling dependency, not a second attempt to create an encounter today.

beats.name: Unremarkable end-of-day goodbye
beats.plot: Rohit says goodbye, carrying the equipment. Ankita turns back to her colleagues' evening surprise. Stop Jan 1 here for Rohit: no accidental neckline view, no stunned silence, no first show, no teasing experiment, no extra return.
